name: voteRewards
author: Takaro
description: Rewards players who vote for this game server on the Takaro Server List. List the server publicly on its Public page first. Only verified votes are rewarded: the voter signed in with a Takaro account linked to their player, or with a linked Steam account. In-game items and commands for an offline player wait until they next join, or until they run the claimvote command.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency given per vote. Skipped when the economy is disabled on this server.

itemSet.title: Item set
itemSet.description: The item set given in game per vote.

role.title: Role
role.description: A role assigned to the voter.

roleDurationHours.title: Role duration (hours)
roleDurationHours.description: How long the role lasts. 0 makes it permanent.

commands.title: Console commands
commands.description: Console commands run per vote. Placeholders: {gameId} and {steamId}. A vote matched without Steam (for example on Minecraft) has no {steamId}, and a command using it is skipped.

pendingClaimDays.title: Days an offline reward waits
pendingClaimDays.description: How long in-game items and commands wait for an offline voter.

thanksMessage.title: Thanks message
thanksMessage.description: Sent to the player after the in-game reward is delivered.
thanksMessage.default: Thanks for voting for this server! Your reward has been delivered.

claimvote.helpText: Claim vote rewards that are waiting for you.

deliverPendingOnConnect.description: Delivers vote rewards that waited for the player to join.
